card.name: Inside ALL-CAPS headings and titles
card.fires_on: Words, punctuation or word parts inside an ALL-CAPS heading or instruction line in a drug label, just before the next capitalized heading word. Examples are step numbers' periods, 'BY', 'IN', 'and', and slashes in warning or table titles.

modes.label: Linking words in caps headings
modes.description: Small connecting words or word parts in upper-case warning or table titles.
modes.example: WARNING: SERIOUS INFECTIONS CAUSED<< BY>> ENCAPSULATED BACTERIA

modes.label: Step number periods
modes.description: The period after a step number before an upper-case instruction title.

modes.label: Slash or split caps words
modes.description: A slash or a split part of an upper-case word within a heading.

card.plain: It fires on the small joining marks and words inside capitalized label headings, where more capitals come next.
